title: §5Shady Transaction
description: §5§oI got plenty of guys on the inside. See if you can meet up with one of the &#FF03FERooks§5. They're everywhere on Derse, but usually at the dining area around &#FF03FE63, 123, 340§5.

§o§5If you have something to &#FF03FEtrade§5 him, like a &#FF03FEhamburger§5, he'll usually give something back. Should be some in your &#FF03FEkitchen§5. The most important thing on Derse is knowing who you can trust and who's gonna stab you in the back, so make sure you get these guys' trust.
